excused.reason: Lightspeed's interactive consent screen, documented in prose on the V1 authorization overview (https://api-portal.lsk.lightspeed.app/quick-start/authentication/v1-authentication/v1-authorization-overview, fetched 2026-10-29) and absent from source.json, whose securitySchemes names the V2 OpenID Connect authorizationUrl. This unit serves a stand-in at the documented path that approves automatically; its route summary says so.

The V1 token endpoint, documented in prose only (same page, fetched 2026-10-29): code exchange from query parameters, refresh from a form body, HTTP Basic client authentication, a five-member JSON response. source.json's securitySchemes tokenUrl is the V2 OpenID Connect one, so no operation describes this route.

deviations.reason: The document declares one */* error envelope, on apeGetMenuByIdV2's 503 and on tax-preview-apiTaxBreakdown's 400, 403, 404 and 503, and it types status as a string enum such as '503'; this unit answers that one envelope for every 503, and on the two routes that declare no 503 the body falls back to error_schema, whose status is an integer. One keyword, one pointer, the two routes.

The kernel refuses a token without orders-api at pipeline step 5, before any vendor code runs, and the shaper sees no route, so this 403 keeps the integer-status envelope every other route answers; the document types status as the string enum '403'. The handler's own 400 and 404, and the 503, answer the declared string-status envelope. One keyword per row, one pointer, this route.

webhooks.name: apeOrder notification
webhooks.reason: Every to-go order this unit accepts ends in one of these posts to the endpoint the order names, built by events.py in two shapes: the status-change body and the refusal body for a SKU no menu at the location carries. It is the one outbound delivery this unit models, so it needs no event_types.
